# contributes to frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:contributesToFrame`](gmeow-contributesToFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/contributesToFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

Relates a creative work or content segment to the narrative reference frame it contributes claims to. Broader than [`gmeow:sourceFor`](gmeow-sourceFor.md): a segment may contribute to a frame without being the primary source. Non-functional: an information object may contribute to many frames.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) -> [`gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:contributesToFrame`](gmeow-contributesToFrame.md) from [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) to [`gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeReferenceFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
